answer: Divergent Path Attestation: each agent must submit a decision trace on a random challenge seeded per epoch. Enforcement: identical clones produce identical traces, which are flagged and rejected, while honest agents diverge naturally. The system logs a willow of unique choices per identity. An attacker must run genuinely distinct instances, paying compute and a reef of maintenance per clone. Honest divergence becomes a haven, since copying another agent's path fails the uniqueness check.
